set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-inputs.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Recovered September 22 acceptance: public export/rendering already exists, while privacy lineage remains open. Approved-machine use does not authorize hosted disclosure, Git redistribution or participant consent.

Remaining / next action: Carry a typed recall-text disclosure basis from admitted input through segmentation and workspace/export publication. Distinguish admitted public text, certified pseudonymization and local-only private use; refuse disclosure without its basis. This is required before the ordinary-file CLI publishes non-public recall inventories.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Restored scope from canonical decision note 20260922T223355.877067Z-p79415-c0000-raf3d-hb75cdf:

2026-09-22: the blocking condition was crossed without incident. codec/recall.scala:140 exports recall text and M1/StoryAtlas render it, on redistributable data only. The exit is re-anchored on the public workflow: before bd-01M35B103S2KHRSF853GD2FYHW publishes a recall inventory, the publish path requires a typed recall-text disclosure basis (e.g. PublicCorpusAdmitted(record) | CertifiedPseudonymized(witness) | LocalOnly), derived from the input path and never a caller string. Otherwise it refuses to write recall text. Court: pseudonymized input -> segmented -> exported keeps its witness; raw private input refuses publication; public Sherlock transcripts pass through their admission record. Add a blocking edge to bd-01M35B103S2KHRSF853GD2FYHW only if that workflow will run on non-public recall.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: maintenance. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Retained with its original acceptance scope; recheck against current code before implementation or closure. Not a prerequisite for the annotation-assisted preview.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.
